units.source_text: 五节舞会，于每年十一月间的丑、寅、卯、辰四日内举行。

en.t: The Gosechi dance festival is held every year over the four days of Ox, Tiger, Hare, and Dragon in the eleventh month.

units.source_text: 舞姬共五人，从朝臣及地方官家中选出。

en.t: There are five dancers in all, chosen from the households of courtiers and provincial officials.

units.source_text: 每一舞姬，随带保姆八人、童女二人、其他差役七人。

en.t: Each dancer is accompanied by eight nurse attendants, two young girls, and seven other servants.
